note: Alberta Parks campground on Big Island in Lac La Biche, reached by causeway, 11 km northeast of the town of Lac La Biche; treed sites in six loops, with check-in at the campground store, which also rents canoes, kayaks and paddleboards. The dump station is near the island entrance and the boat launch on Long Island. Most sites are posted at 31 ft and 12 at 21 ft, so choose by length. Comfort cabins and tipis on Long Island. --Claude
